requirements.requirement: Three-field start: organization type, sector, primary goal.
requirements.acceptance: Start without login; no other profile field is required before first question.

requirements.requirement: Offer five-question preliminary preview.
requirements.acceptance: Preview says provisional; no definitive overall band.

requirements.requirement: Ask all 14 universally applicable scored indicators.
requirements.acceptance: Question order and options exactly match signed question_bank.json.

requirements.requirement: Present conditional evidence probes once and only when triggered.
requirements.acceptance: Close probes made inert after edits; no score changes from probes.

requirements.requirement: Offer optional extended 18-question AWS-inspired technical diagnostic.
requirements.acceptance: Apply conditions; show why skipped; deep questions never directly change overall score.

requirements.requirement: Capture a selected value stream and one operational pain point.
requirements.acceptance: Optional fields; no contact information or confidential data required.

requirements.requirement: Capture one-off or recurring budget ceiling separately and staff capacity.
requirements.acceptance: Neither budget field changes score, gates or confidence.

requirements.requirement: Produce deterministic score intervals with unknown handling.
requirements.acceptance: Property and golden-fixture tests pass; exact integer semantics.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate governance, safety and data blocker rules.
requirements.acceptance: Every gate has traceable input IDs and exact precedence.

requirements.requirement: Choose primary and up to two secondary paths and ranked next actions.
requirements.acceptance: 3 actions max; no unfounded vendor or cash claims; output stable.

requirements.requirement: Generate complete accessible HTML report.
requirements.acceptance: All mandatory report contract sections render on mobile.

requirements.requirement: Support browser print/save-as-PDF plus copy summary.
requirements.acceptance: All content prints in supported browsers; no promise of PDF file object.

requirements.requirement: Allow a user-controlled WhatsApp enquiry.
requirements.acceptance: User sees exact payload before external messaging app; no automatic transfer.

requirements.requirement: Provide an offline/manual consultant review protocol.
requirements.acceptance: Review template captures evidence, acceptance, next action, follow-up.

requirements.requirement: Autosave disclosed tab draft; opt-in longer local save.
requirements.acceptance: Crash/resume and multi-tab conflict tests pass.

requirements.requirement: Default to no network transmission of answers.
requirements.acceptance: Network test confirms zero app-origin assessment transfers.

requirements.requirement: Publish pure static artifacts to GitHub Pages subpath.
requirements.acceptance: Full assessment completes from /silverspark-compass/ including refresh/hash routes.

requirements.requirement: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA target, keyboard and screen reader.
requirements.acceptance: Axe + manual keyboard + target-device tests; no critical defects.

requirements.requirement: Stay functional on low-end Android and narrow mobile.
requirements.acceptance: Pre-rendered landing, limited JS, report lazy-loaded; lab performance reviewed.

requirements.requirement: Freeze rule, question, and report versions.
requirements.acceptance: Exact report input & version produce stable output with stored fixtures.

requirements.requirement: Deploy only from approved gated Actions job.
requirements.acceptance: Required checks lint/type/unit/e2e/axe/build and protected main.

requirements.requirement: Do not store tokens, provider secrets, contact details by default.
requirements.acceptance: Static artifacts contain no secrets; CSP limitations documented.

requirements.requirement: S0–S8 with signed handoff.
requirements.acceptance: Each stage outputs tests, artifact hashes, reviewer sign-off and next scope.
